title: kengyilia thoroldiana
intro: Kengyilia thoroldiana, commonly known as Tibetan needle grass, is a perennial grass species native to the high-altitude regions of the Tibetan Plateau. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood sugar levels. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of Kengyilia thoroldiana include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
